emergencyBar.prompt: If someone is in immediate danger or severely hurt, call an ambulance now:

evidence.title: How this works
evidence.lead: If someone is sick or hurt, answer a few questions about their age, symptoms, and vital signs. The system checks their answers against official government health rules and tells you what to do next — whether to rest at home, visit your local clinic, or get to a hospital right away. It does not use AI to guess diagnoses.
evidence.fact1Text: Written directly from verified NHM, IMNCI, and ASHA clinical manuals.
evidence.fact2Text: Every decision traces to an official page in the government guideline.
evidence.fact3Text: If symptoms don't match a rule, it tells you to see a health worker in person.
evidence.fact4Text: Guides you to the right place: Sub-centre, PHC, CHC, or District Hospital.

heroCta.title: Clinical Symptom Assessment
heroCta.lead: Answer questions regarding age, symptoms, and optional vitals. Triage follows verified NHM and MoHFW clinical protocols to recommend the appropriate facility level.

demographics.title: Who is this assessment for?
demographics.subtitle: Clinical rules depend on age, sex, and whether the person is pregnant or recently gave birth.
demographics.nameError: Please enter the person's full name.
demographics.nameLengthError: Full name must be at least 2 characters.
demographics.nameFormatError: Name should contain letters and spaces only.
demographics.phoneHint: Required for referral tracking, SMS updates, and healthcare worker follow-up.
demographics.phoneError: Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8, or 9.
demographics.phoneStartInvalid: Mobile number must start with 6, 7, 8, or 9 (e.g. 9876543210)
demographics.villageError: Please enter the village or town name.
demographics.villageLengthError: Village or town name must be at least 2 characters.
demographics.addressPlaceholder: e.g. House No. 12, Main Road, Near Primary School
demographics.addressError: Please enter residential address or landmark.
demographics.addressLengthError: Address must be at least 3 characters.
demographics.abhaHint: If available, this connects the triage record to your digital health locker.
demographics.ageError: Please enter an age between 0 and 120 years.
demographics.ageHint: For a baby under one year, use decimals (like 0.2 for two months). For older children or adults, enter their age in years.
demographics.isPostpartum: Did this person give birth in the last 6 weeks?

symptoms.title: What symptoms are they having?
symptoms.subtitle: Select everything that applies. Red items are urgent danger signs.
symptoms.durationTitle: How long have symptoms been present?
symptoms.emptyError: Please select at least one symptom to evaluate.
symptoms.dangerSignAlert: You selected one or more urgent danger signs. This person will likely need medical attention right away.

nlp.panelTitle: Describe symptoms in your own words (or use voice)
nlp.placeholder: Type or speak symptoms, e.g. "high fever and headache since yesterday"
nlp.noSpeechSupport: Voice input is not supported in this browser. Please type symptoms instead.
nlp.micError: Could not access microphone. Please check permissions and try again.
nlp.emptyTranscript: Please type or speak some symptoms first.
nlp.noMatch: No recognisable symptoms found. Try describing differently or select from the list below.
nlp.extractFailed: Could not identify symptoms. Please try again or select from the list.
nlp.confirmSubtitle: Tap a symptom to unselect it, then confirm.
nlp.confirmHint: Unselect any that were not mentioned. You can also add more from the list after confirming.

vitals.title: Did you measure any vitals?
vitals.subtitle: These are optional. If you have a thermometer, BP monitor, or pulse oximeter at home, enter what you measured. Otherwise, skip this step.
vitals.pulseHint: Normal resting pulse for an adult is 60 to 100
vitals.bpHolder: 140/90 or higher indicates high blood pressure
vitals.spo2Hint: Below 90% is a serious warning sign
vitals.rrHint: For small children, fast breathing is an important sign of pneumonia
